description: What used cars cost in one Spanish province (Madrid, Sevilla, Barcelona, A Coruña...): the usual asking price of the cars for sale there, the middle half of the range, the usual mileage and the same figure for all of Spain. Narrow it with a make, or a make and a model. Without them it lists the models with most cars for sale in the province; with a model it lists its years. Answers "how much is a used X in Y" and "is it cheaper in Y". Cite the page URL it returns.

model.description: Model, optional and only with make, e.g. "León"

name: province_market
title: Used car prices in a Spanish province
